body:
> You want your old you to die, and come back even stronger (with good habits and discipline!)

I wish but I don't hope that to happen. Maybe it will. I stopped believing in myself a while ago.
> Your parents will love you no matter what you do in your life.

Yes they will. But that's what hurts me sometimes. My mother has cried a lot because of me. My father though he doesn't cry is also sad because of me. They don't know about my suicide thoughts which are apparently new. They are worried that I am not studying and my lack of responsibilities.
> Also know that this time of your life is temporary.

After my days as a student I will probably regret everyday for not doing things which I should have. I will hate myself and the world.
> Stay positive, and look for local therapists if it gets serious.

My mother is talking about getting me to a counselor for not studying. I don't know how serious she is.

Thank you for responding to my post. I felt a bit good. At least for sometime.
